notes.title: Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery Launches Today!
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers! 

We’re excited to reveal a new era in the [i]Hidden Through Time[/i] series… [i]three[/i] eras actually!

Today we’re launching [i]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/i], a cozy new entry into the hidden-object genre, taking players on 33 hand-illustrated new adventures across Victorian, Noir and Sci-Fi settings.
If you've enjoyed the [i]Hidden Through Time[/i] series, you'll love this new full entry into the catalogue!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892414/d45d8f5d9e3bd2a3b77ca3956155c46e28bac0bf.gif[/img]

Take your attention to detail to new heights and join Sherlock Holmes as he looks for clues in the Victorian era; meet Anna, a young astronaut as she seeks out new worlds in the Sci-Fi campaign; and look back to the mysterious 40’s in the Noir era as Detective Jane Spade investigates high and low in The Case of the Missing Corgi.

[i]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/i] finds new ways to play, with Reality Shift, switching time and weather across levels and revealing new secrets. Uncover the Map Editor, allowing players to create and share their own levels with over 1000 new objects and 500 new customisable characters to build the ultimate hide and seek adventure!
Don’t fancy creating? Sit back and cast your eyes over the infinite community-created possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892414/303bb8501100c29ebe007625e5bea8fd7c86655f.gif[/img]

We hope you’ll love playing this all new entry into the [i]Hidden Through Time[/i] series, as much as we enjoyed creating it. Discover our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Zt46zE47rU]Discord community[/url] and seek us out on [url=https://x.com/RoguesideGames]Twitter/X[/url]. 

Find you there! 

George 
Rogueside 

Check it out on Steam! ⤵️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094680/Hidden_Through_Time_2_Discovery/

notes.title: Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery is releasing on August 13
notes.notes:
Are you ready to embark on an enchanting adventure like never before? We're thrilled to announce the upcoming release of Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery!
Coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, Switch, and Xbox Series X|S on Tuesday August 13. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/070ee77e42599545280fb9ef74c5cb36000bfd8f.png[/img]

notes.title: Board the spaceship to Discovery!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce we are expanding the Hidden Through Time franchise with the next installment; [b]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/b]!

[previewyoutube=RdL6dcTADFw;full][/previewyoutube]
Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery is coming soon to PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Mobile (Android, iOS).

Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery is a cozy hidden object game that has you searching for hidden objects in hand-drawn, interactive landscapes. Ignite your imagination, unleash your inner artist with the editor and share your masterpieces with the world!

[h2]Key features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Relaxing Gameplay[/b]
A relaxing and cozy experience is ensured as the game doesn’t feature timers or similar mechanics to put pressure on the player. They’re able to enjoy the game at their own speed.

[*] [b]Map Editor[/b]
Players have access to assets from all three eras (Noir, Victorian, and Sci-Fi), giving the ability to bring their imagination to life in the Map Editor, where creations can be shared with the community.

[*] [b]Reality shift[/b]
Seen in the previous game, Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic, the Reality Shift feature makes a return. This allows players to explore a whole host of new objects as they can shift between time and season, giving more depth to each map, enabling more space for storytelling within one map. 
[/list]
[h2]Wishlist on Steam![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094680

notes.title: Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h2]Start your magical adventure now! [/h2]

We are very excited to announce [b]Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic is OUT NOW on Steam and GOG[/b]! Releases on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and mobile coming soon.

[previewyoutube=L-QeQ3iAckE;full][/previewyoutube]
Join Clicky on a new, enchanted adventure in Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic! This charming 2D hidden object game is sure to delight with its playful tone, cozy vibes and endless fun. Search for all the hidden objects scattered around beautiful hand-drawn worlds, and unlock more as you go. With both a single player campaign and an online mode where you can create your own dreamworld, the adventure never ends!

[h3]Purchase Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic now and enjoy a 10% discount.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2304640/Hidden_Through_Time_2_Myths__Magic/

[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Campaign[/b]
Set out on a journey through four magical eras, uncovering all the items hidden within. Find objects to advance through the stages and explore the storyline of each era – who knows what secrets you’ll uncover next!

[*] [b]Reality shift[/b]
Master the power of time with the brand-new Reality Shift feature, adding an extra dimension to your hidden object experience. Shift from Day to Night, Summer to Winter, … and explore maps in multiple states. But keep an eye out for those objects only present in one or the other!

[*] [b]Increased interactions[/b]
Interact with pretty much anything and feel the map come to life! Everything you click on gives some sort of audible or visible feedback. Go out and discover what your favorite interaction is. And click on the goat, you'll be amazed by it's capabilities. 

[*] [b]Secret objectives[/b]
Test your acumen with this new type of objective! Find them all and unlock the final challenge of every era. Be wary though, as these objectives do not have a hint, but there are a few clues to help you. Maps contain only one secret objective.

[*] [b]Create and share[/b] 
Have a creative streak? The improved Architect Mode lets you build and share your own unique experiences with greater ease than ever before! Show off your map-making skills and see how your creations stack up against those of others. Create your own maps in the Architect and share them with the community to play!
[/list]
Adventure is but a Click(y) away! Start yours now!

Join the official [url=www.discord.gg/JQjaKTn76n]Hidden Through Time Discord[/url] to learn more and chat with the development team - and be sure to follow us on social media for all the latest news and updates.

notes.title: Play The Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic Demo!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2304640/Hidden_Through_Time_2_Myths__Magic/

Hey there, Travelers! 

We're super stoked to let you know that the [b]Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic demo[/b] is now live as part of Steam NextFest! From today, you've got a whole week to try it out [b]until June 26th at 7pm CEST[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952380/fbfd75de8905a61bc33906820e1c7c801252d63e.png[/img]
In this demo, you'll get to play [b]two early campaign levels[/b]: one set in the Ancient Greek era and another in the rad 80s Fantasies. And that's not all—[b]we've also unlocked the map editor[/b]! It's the perfect place to let your creativity run wild and bring your wildest fantasies to life. Once you're done, upload your map to the server, and everyone in the community can enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952380/53970dfbda40035f9cc434892efcb6c6aa7097a1.png[/img]
Just a heads up, though—some cool features in the demo are a bit limited for now. You'll only get to experience two out of the four epic eras (Arabian Nights and Medieval Fantasy will be added when the full release drops), and state shifting is currently available only for sunny and snowy mood (but we'll have more options in the full release, promise!).

This demo will give you a taste of what's coming, but trust us, there's a ton more to discover! 

Together with the demo, we also have a [b]new gameplay trailer[/b]! Check it out!

[previewyoutube=CHzO6HFhrWM;full][/previewyoutube]
To make things even greater, [b]we're holding a contest[/b] to celebrate the demo release! Enter for a chance to [b]win one of five codes[/b] for the full release of Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic. All you gotta do is create your own map and share it with the community. The winners will be chosen by the community themselves by in-game likes. [b]Cutoff on Tuesday, June 27th, at 10am CEST[/b].

Make sure to hit the button marked below to publish your map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952380/cee2886898157a6f26fe3dbf1e6f27f902a9362a.png[/img]

Thanks a million for all the love and support you've shown us. Good luck to everyone in the contest! Stay up to date with the latest deets on our socials or check out www.rogueside.com for all the juicy info.

notes.title: Hidden Through Time 2: Developer Update #1
notes.notes:
Greetings Travelers! 

Welcome to the first developer update! In this update, we are excited to share with you a glimpse into the captivating worlds that awaits you in Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic. And today we are unveiling which eras will be in the game. 

Let's dive in and discover the enchanting stories that will ignite your imagination!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/a54f7f206d84c1caa42c463a1472426fb6747177.png[/img]
Immerse yourself in the enchanting tales of ancient Greece, brought to life on the grand stage of the theater. From the majestic Mount Olympus to the treacherous labyrinth of Minos Island, embark on a mythical journey filled with gods, heroes, and mythical creatures. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure where legends come alive before your very eyes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/45303d70d4b7c0ccb2f7c73f8b131c575491f751.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/624035e2db8d45bd1a334d538697aee52a862276.png[/img]
Transport yourself to a world of knights, castles, and ancient mysteries. Embark on a mesmerizing quest alongside a brave party of adventurers as they seek the guidance of the Lady of the Lake, venture into mystical forests and face off against evil. Find the hidden objects to protect the land, and become a legendary hero yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/0736e09bbc5d2c40994cee0c5d7607a022b74d75.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/394c3eaa568fb67504f1d5684624b23b1374f6e8.png[/img]
Journey alongside Scheherazade, the master storyteller, as she enchants the Sultan with her nightly tales. From the legendary Hanged Gardens of Babylon to the thrilling Voyages of Sinbad. Delve into the rich tapestry of Arabian folklore, where tales of magic, bravery, and destiny come alive in a world of captivating wonder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/1e2ecaf36e26335db71c9c8063345ad2030301a8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/d2fc0ad0864638b16eefa0143cab39fc14bd3dfd.png[/img]
Step into the groovy world of the 80s Fantasy and get ready to relish in the nostalgia of an era filled with vibrant music and colorful fashion. Immerse yourself in the whimsical blend of magic and 80s flair as you accompany Willow on her delightful journey of self-discovery, friendship, and a touch of teenage romance. Get ready to rock the retro fantasy like never before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/da7bb31cd5ba454feaae84dba3316bef4d44d090.png[/img]
As we conclude this Developer Update, we hope you've been captivated by the enticing tales and immersive experiences that await you in Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic. Prepare to lose yourself in the allure of ancient Greece, the mystique of the medieval era, the enchantment of Arabian Nights, and the nostalgic wonder of the 80s Fantasy. 

Get ready to uncover hidden treasures and forge unforgettable memories. 

Stay tuned for more updates as we work tirelessly to bring these incredible worlds to life. Thank you for joining us on this exciting journey!

Rogueside

notes.title: Hidden Through Time: Definite Edition OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=dXCkORPEDsY;full][/previewyoutube]
In partnership with ININ Games we are launching Hidden Through Time: Definite Edition*, a physical edition of the complete game (including all DLCs), for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4!

Hidden Through Time is a cute game of hide and seek with objects scattered throughout the wonderful history of our world! Cryptic hints will help you discover every small (sometimes REALLY small) secret as you explore the colourful hand-drawn levels. 

Find yourself in the Stone Age and witness the course of history as you click through Ancient Egypt, the Middle Ages and the lawless Wild West, while seeking for items that will grant you passage to the next (st)age. Make your way through epic and full-of-details sceneries that expand in size and difficulty as players progress, and enjoy the 5 additional adventures included in our Definite Edition (newest DLCs - Aztec Rituals and Pirate Treasures - included)!

Get Hidden Through Time: Definite Edition* for Nintendo Switch or PlayStation 4 at https://www.iningames.com/games/hidden-through-time

*only available in Europe

notes.title: January Must Try Maps!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Timewalkers![/h2]

First of all a belated happy New Year to all of you! We hope you enjoyed the holidays and are fully energized to tackle 2022! The love and support we've received during 2021 has been insane! So many people created new maps and brought their fantasy alive with the latest DLC (Road to Rome). Here's to another year of Hidden Through Time!

Let's start off the new year with some awesome maps we've highlighted throughout December.

[h2]Spooky Island by Yana&Zab[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/67f9de33e53ed70fcf1f718d8e01645d2e9d0057.jpg[/img]
The first map we highlighted in December was Spooky Island, created by Yana&Zab.

A desolate island, lost somewhere in the vast ocean, haunted by ghosts and spirits of those buried there. Only the bravest of souls with nerves of steel dare to tread on their land. Will you be one of those brave souls locating all the hidden objects?

[h2]Noli Me Tangere by Karlen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/19e904ba547094e2bd1468138ffe625fe2024b1e.jpg[/img]
The next spotlight was cast on Noli Me Tangere, created by Karlen.

Interestingly enough, this map is inspired by José Rizal's same-titled novel Noli Me Tángere. Telling part of the story from the main characters Crisostomo and Elias. In this map they are in a lot of trouble. Can you find them before it is too late?

[h2]Cartmen by #gamersvensson[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/b164d12d585a2e6a3260db69cb658fa2665a404a.jpg[/img]
Lastly, the spot was cast on Cartman, created by #gamersvensson.

#gamersvensson is becoming some kind of regular in these spotlights with all the amazing maps he has created, and he keeps delivering! In this new creation titled "Cartman" he took inspiration from everything cart related. So you'll be looking for a lot of cart... stuff. Up to you to find all the related objects and references!

These were the highlighted maps throughout December. We hope you'll enjoy them as much as we did! Don't worry if you are already done with these maps, as there are many more awesome maps waiting for you. Have fun clicking away and discovering all the secrets Hidden Through Time!

See you next time for more awesome maps! 👋

Keep on creating, and maybe your map will be featured throughout January!

notes.title: Round-up November Community Spotlight!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi Timewalkers![/b]⌛🚶

It's time for the monthly round-up of the must try online maps featured in November! During November we've seen a ton of new online maps created by our community emerge, and what a joy they were. In this round-up we'll be showing you five maps we thoroughly enjoyed playing, and we hope you will too if you haven't yet!

So without further ado, let's get started!

[h2]Medieval Village by nahkarotsi[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/654e2ec09bac528900841fe677734265c494fc4f.jpg[/img]
What is life like living in a Medieval village? Well... take a look! This simplistic map, created by nahkarotsi, gives you an insight on how those people might have actually lived. This map holds fourteen objects for you to discover, can you find them all? Go hang out with Clicky and test your skills now! :)

[h2]World Marketplace by Faegirl[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/0c14e08407725b34a559ff74311acd23b1b4dfb5.jpg[/img]
This isn't your regular marketplace, this is the World Marketplace! People are just chilling, enjoying themselves and the atmosphere, looking for some new items to purchase. The stalls are decking out their finest wares, it's even got some attention from people higher up! Word goes out the emperor's wife is visiting the market. Do you spot her?

[h2]Harvest in Tuscany by staceppa123[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/3056679cc1ad4f0e3718741f52ba2fece9ea14e7.jpg[/img]
It's that time again in Tuscany! The most joyous of times where the inhabitants are celebrating their harvest and creating the nectar of the Gods, delicious wine! No machinery needed, for these revolutionary people use their feet to extract the juice from the grapes! It just adds that little extra flavor. it's your time to shine and find all the hidden objects, are you ready?

[h2]Ave Caesar Extended by #gamersvensson[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/1c74eefd791960e067c73dca258c80e804c11a94.jpg[/img]
Ave Caesar! The Gladiators must be fueling with energy, hearing the roar of the crowd. Can you hear it? I wonder who will win the race? Will it be one of the many horses, or will the only camel be victorious! Let's find out together with Clicky. Go, and lose yourself in the crowd.

[h2]Ataque ao Castelo by JonasFrid[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/38455bab4a1e9d12af698d1deaafb7a6980763a6.jpg[/img]
Protect the castle, and our king! Goblins have appeared from the surrounding forest and started laying siege upon our beautiful castle! Time to gather the troops and knock down their attack. Clicky wants you to find out how they can be helped. Look for the sword in stone, draw its power and save the castle.

These were the five maps we've highlighted throughout November. We hope you'll enjoy them as much as we did! Don't worry if you are already done with these, there are many more awesome maps waiting for you. Have fun clicking away and discovering all the secrets Hidden Through Time!

See you next time for more awesome maps! 👋

Keep on creating, and maybe your map will be featured throughout December!

notes.title: October Community Spotlight!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi Timewalkers! [/b]⌛🚶

October has come to an end, and with it the Halloween festivities have concluded. This also means a new month has started! Let's start off November the right way: with a round-up of some awesome maps created by you, the lovely people in our community! The newly created maps in October have been spectacular! We've played many of them and highlighted one of the best creations each week. 

So without further ado, let’s go over our favourite community maps created during October. Enjoy!

[h3][b]ENCHANTED OASIS[/b] by ca1cifer[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/8e8edf0b0540ca84f30f9a3c653bf974eb6451d6.jpg[/img]
Nine cabins in the woods. When put like that it sounds more spooky than it actually is though! It's actually looking like a pretty nice place. These cabins are built in some kind of resort, an Oasis. Even better yet, it's an Enchanted Oasis! What makes it so special though? A lot of people seem to be enjoying the peacefulness and quietness, and we can't blame them.

Are you in need for some relaxing gameplay? Clicky has arranged a cabin for you, meet up with him and start exploring!

[h3][b]MONTYPYTHONHOLYGRAIL[/b] by brookeahome[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/d2d07ce10016e75acec6654b6bb0cf3e142a72d9.jpg[/img]
Recreating famous movie scenes in Hidden Through Time is actually such a baller move, peak creative performance. Wander around the map and discover the different scenes reenacting the iconic Monty Python and the Holy Grail. A tip for those of you who haven't seen the movie, go watch it! 

Fetchez la vache! Need there to be said more?

[h3][b]DRUINS[/b]by coojie44[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/118b092057582be074e89c674db1e70d65b1bf64.jpg[/img]
The Gauls are such an awesome, bad-ass tribe, and we love to see more maps using these assets! So the Druins, short for Druidic Ruins we would say, is a sacred place where all the Gaul druids perform their rituals. High up the mountains, with vision over their village, is where the magic happens.

Discover the area with Clicky, but make sure you don't fall into the magic potion, like some other Gauls have done!

[h3][b]DRAGONS HOARD[/b] by creative_paws_gp[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/92180acb37ef3edcf810d55d8979ec48154d56f6.jpg[/img]
This is the last map we'll be highlighting for the month of October. Dragons Hoard brings back the Viking theme, paired with mythical creatures (dragons are awesome!). The island is ready for exploration, with a lot of hidden (and not so hidden) treasure scattered around.

Are you up for a challenge to spot them all? Clicky will be by your side, but do look out for the fierce dragons though! 

These were the four maps we've highlighted throughout October. We hope you'll enjoy them as much as we did! Don't worry if you are already done with these, there are many more awesome waiting for you. Have fun clicking away and discovering all the secrets Hidden Through Time!

See you next time for more awesome maps! 👋

Rogueside

PS: Keep on creating, and maybe your map will be featured throughout November!

notes.title: September Community Spotlight!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi Timewalkers![/b] ⌛🚶

We are here with another spotlight shining on the beautiful maps created by our lovely community during September. We've seen loads of fantastic maps pop up the past months, and September has definitely continued the trend!

Without further ado, let's get into the [b]must try community maps[/b] created in [b]September[/b]!

[h3][b]De Bello Gallo[/b] by fyberduck[/h3]
A great map created by Hidden Through Time's finest fyberduck! De Bello Gallo will take you back ages to the beautiful aesthetics of Ancient Rome. There's a plethora of objects hidden throughout the city, scattered around houses and in the forest. Finding them all will take some time, but we know you are up for a challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/175fa4565b4e9d236ed0700ec4707161edc92698.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Forest Find[/b] by mushergal[/h3]

notes.title: Three Must Try Community Maps - July
notes.notes:
[b]Hi Timewalkers![/b] ⌛🚶

We hope you are all doing well and not getting blasted too hard by the summer heat. Let’s start off the summer with some nice chill community made maps to cool you down! Thanks a lot for creating so many maps in the past month. It’s awesome to see the community bring their ideas to life within Hidden Through Time. We’ve enjoyed playing all of them, and made a selection of the maps we enjoyed the most.

So without further ado, let’s get started!

These are [b]July’s must try community maps[/b] we've selected for you to enjoy!

[h2][b]Kitsuka – by K9Countess[/b][/h2]
Using the Japanese objects and buildings to create a nice little community straight from Feudal Japan. There’s so much going on in this village. I bet a good place to start is near the market so you don't miss out on all the sumo wrestling action. Food and games for everyone! Afterwards you can go to the onsen baths to blow off some steam! Immerse yourself in this Japanese community, together with Clicky, and search for all the hidden objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/8be2109628f1d1c9dba65bcf0926b994b9604472.png[/img]

Wander around in the botanical garden and look for twenty (!) missing items, but be wary of the tiger though. You can get lost in this maze for hours, but it’s definitely worth it. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/8f4154c50b3496f4324b8d905bd0bbce3c2c29e0.png[/img]

notes.title: Hidden Through Time: Road to Rome DLC OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/6e4cf2da1cd129c7cf7276c324d3e699ff05c804.png[/img]
[h1]Road to Rome DLC is OUT NOW! [/h1]

Carpe Diem, Timewalkers! 🍎

Have you conquered the viking clans in the North? Learned all the Legends of the samurai and dojos? And are you hankering to explore a new timeline with Clicky? Well, today is the day!

Accompany Clicky in his adventure through the Ancient Roman Empire! Explore the streets of the city, hear the roar of the crowd and enjoy the amazing architecture!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536700/Hidden_Through_Time__Road_to_Rome/

The Road to Rome DLC adds ten new campaign levels and over 300 new objects, characters and creatures for level creators to make amazing levels with!

The Roman Empire – an ancient empire, centered on the city of Rome. Not only known for their ruthless conquering of the world, but also for their amazing architecture, intriguing mythology and powerful emperors. 

In Hidden Through Time – Road to Rome you will accompany Clicky on his adventure through the streets of Rome! Hear the roar of the arena, march into battle with the troops and earn the favor of the gods! Observe your surroundings with care and discover the secrets hidden in plain sight.

This DLC includes ten new levels ranging from Gaul settlements to the monumental Colosseum! It also features more than 300 new Roman Empire themed objects and characters, which will be in the level editor upon purchase!

People who don’t own this DLC will still be able to play through user created maps that use objects from the Road to Rome DLC.

Recline in your comfortable lectus, grab an amphora of your favorite drink and prepare to make yourself comfortable. 

After all, Rome wasn’t built in a day.

[b]2. Bandit Camp[/b]
The bandits are hiding near the railroad tracks. They’ve found gold in the mines and are hoping to sell it in the nearest town. Gold isn’t the only thing they’re hiding from you though, take a look around and find out what else is going on here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/f8e21b7a70c6877aebdd0bf7ed004ce4d213df9c.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Forest Sanctuary[/b]
Deep in the forest, there’s a sanctuary for creatures of all origins. Goblins and humans alike. The people who come here lay down their arms and talk to one another about their lives. However, not everything is the way it seems. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/163369d7863b07ab1fc13105c065af9ff2d30e39.jpg[/img]
